title_en: We are selling Land+Area in the area of ​​Mullet!
description_en: We are selling Land+Area in the area of ​​Mullet! The land has a total surface of 1000 m2, where 300 m2 are land and 700 m2 are. It is located in a very good habitable area and is surrounded by gardens. The land has a regular rectangular shape, very suitable for villas, sheds, etc. In the photo is the project for the construction of two villas. It has proper documentation. The land is also sold in exchange for another property in Tirana. For more information or a visit to the property, contact me!
